meta.scope: Taiwan Batch 4 — R&D / innovation intensity, national GHG inventory, regional contrast (special municipalities vs counties), additional structural and environmental depth. Explicit referenced_by lists for force-layout edge strength.
meta.strategy_note: R&D-to-GDP near 4.1 % is a defining high-tech feature that links tightly to the semiconductor cluster. GHG inventory anchors the environmental layer. Regional contrast (six special municipalities concentrate ~70 % of population) parallels the Seoul Capital Area and Tokyo patterns.

candidates.title: National R&D Expenditure and Personnel Statistics
candidates.publisher: National Science and Technology Council (NSTC) / DGBAS-related
candidates.description: Annual statistics on total R&D expenditure (recently surpassed NT$1 trillion / ~4.1 % of GDP), breakdown by performing and funding sector, and R&D personnel. Private-sector and large-enterprise dominance is pronounced; science-park firms account for a rising share of business R&D.
candidates.notes: High-authority uniqueness node. R&D intensity ~4.1 % of GDP is among the world’s highest and is heavily concentrated in the same large electronics/semiconductor firms that dominate industrial production and exports. Creates dense edges into the core technology cluster.

candidates.title: National Greenhouse Gas Inventory Report
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Environment / Climate Change Administration
candidates.description: Annual national GHG inventory compiled voluntarily in line with UNFCCC / Paris Agreement transparency standards (even though Taiwan is not a formal party). Reports total and sectoral emissions, carbon sinks and net emissions from 1990 onward.
referenced_by: Energy Statistics Handbook and generation-mix data
Climate Change Response Act implementation documents
candidates.notes: Core environmental statistics node. Links energy (especially the low-nuclear, high-gas/renewables mix) to climate-policy and industrial-emission edges.

candidates.title: Climate Change Response Act
candidates.description: Primary domestic climate legislation that mandates the national GHG inventory, sets the legal basis for mitigation and adaptation policy, and structures institutional responsibilities.
referenced_by: Subsequent climate-policy white papers and regulations
candidates.notes: Foundational recurring-citation legal node for the environmental cluster, parallel to the Statistics Act for the statistical system.

candidates.title: Regional contrast — Special Municipalities vs counties / population and economic concentration
candidates.publisher: DGBAS / Ministry of the Interior / local governments
candidates.description: Statistical framework highlighting the extreme concentration of population and economic activity in the six special municipalities (Taipei, New Taipei, Taoyuan, Taichung, Tainan, Kaohsiung), which together account for roughly 70 % of the population, versus more rapidly ageing and lower-density counties (especially eastern and agricultural counties).
referenced_by: Population and vital statistics by locality
candidates.notes: Spatial hierarchy node. Parallel to Seoul Capital Area and Tokyo/Okinawa contrasts. Essential for force-layout geographic clustering and for capturing core–periphery differentials.

candidates.title: Taipei–Hsinchu high-tech / administrative axis statistics
candidates.publisher: DGBAS / Science Park administrations / local statistical offices
candidates.description: Combined statistical view of Taipei (administrative and financial centre) and Hsinchu (science-park / semiconductor heartland) as the primary high-value axis of the Taiwanese economy.
candidates.notes: Focused regional node that tightens the link between administrative capital and the foundry cluster.

candidates.title: Input-Output Tables / Inter-industry relations
candidates.description: Periodic detailed input-output tables showing inter-industry transactions, value added and final demand. Critical for tracing the semiconductor and electronics supply chains within the domestic economy.
candidates.notes: Structural backbone node. Parallel to Japan and Korea I-O tables; especially valuable for mapping the dense domestic linkages around electronics.

candidates.title: SME / Small and Medium Enterprise statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Economic Affairs / Small and Medium Enterprise Administration
candidates.description: Statistics on the number, employment, sales and financial conditions of SMEs, which still account for the large majority of enterprises and a substantial share of employment even while large electronics firms dominate R&D and exports.
candidates.notes: Balances the large-firm / semiconductor picture. Useful for dual-economy edges.

candidates.title: Tourism statistics (inbound / outbound)
candidates.publisher: Tourism Administration / Ministry of Transportation and Communications
candidates.description: Statistics on visitor arrivals, outbound travel, tourism receipts and related services-trade indicators.
referenced_by: Services trade in the Balance of Payments
candidates.notes: Supporting services and external node; sensitive to cross-strait and regional travel conditions.

candidates.title: Health and medical statistics (beyond long-term care)
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Health and Welfare / National Health Insurance Administration
candidates.description: Statistics on health status, medical utilisation, National Health Insurance expenditure and related system indicators.
candidates.notes: Complements the long-term care node and strengthens the health–ageing cluster.

candidates.title: Wage and salary statistics / Earnings survey
candidates.description: Statistics on earnings by industry, occupation, firm size and other characteristics. Source for wage-gap and labour-cost analysis.
referenced_by: Labour productivity and unit labour cost series
candidates.notes: Links labour, cost and household-income clusters.
